benchmark: WebArena (web-arena-x/webarena @ dce04686, native test loop + native evaluator_router)
scope: replacement scope: all 812 WebArena tasks, trained actor pavlov-public-portfolio-bf16 (seed809 merged) as the agent LLM, CoT prompt p_cot_id_actree_2s, accessibility-tree obs, max 30 steps. Not pooled with any original-contract number.
metric: task success rate (native evaluator score == 1.0); errors and ungraded (judge-unavailable) tasks counted as failures in the denominator

spend_breakdown.note: list-price estimates (N2 $0.031611/vCPU-h, $0.004237/GB-h; pd-balanced $0.10/GB-mo). Shared trained-actor endpoint (Modal) is billed to the shared_trained_actor_endpoint cap, not E6.

deviations: Compute: GCP VM e6-webarena-0927 (n2-highmem-16, us-central1-a) instead of the AWS AMI (EC2 quota 1 vCPU). Site images from gs://arvindcr-webarena-images-20260422; map served by am1n3e/webarena-verified-map (tiles/nominatim/OSRM, iptables 8080->3000); wikipedia via kiwix-serve 3.3.0.
Thin runner code/e6_driver.py mirrors run.py::test() (same env, prompt agent, early_stop, auto_login, evaluator_router); the fail-closed zvf machinery was not used.

Agent LLM: trained actor via OpenAI-compatible vLLM, temperature 0, non-thinking, max_tokens 384; few-shot system(name=example_*) turns mapped to user/assistant (Qwen template rejects non-leading system msgs); tiktoken cl100k_base for obs truncation.

LLM judge: native gpt-4-1106-preview is retired (404); swapped to openai/gpt-4.1 via OpenRouter. The OpenRouter account had no credit for the whole run (0 successful judge calls; HTTP 402), and the OPENAI_API_KEY account is also out of credit. 114 tasks needed llm_fuzzy_match/llm_ua_match: 6 were resolved to 0 without the judge (another check in the product score was already 0; code/offline_regrade.py), 108 remain ungraded and are counted as failures.
Per-task wall-clock timeout 1500 s; screenshots off (text-only agent).

Splits by site (splits/, seed 20260927) ran in parallel, one worker per site. At 08:52Z the last 103 w2_shopping_admin tasks were sharded over 3 workers: original container :7780 plus two fresh containers of the same official image on :7781/:7782 (config_files URL-rewritten copies; code/w2_shard.sh).
No per-task environment reset (same as native run.py); state-changing tasks run sequentially per site container.
caveats: Headline score is a lower bound: 108 ungraded string_match tasks count as failures. If all passed, the score would be 0.2438; the score over graded tasks only is 0.1278. Regrade later with code/offline_regrade.py once a judge key has credit (needs the WebArena config_files, which were on the deleted VM; regenerate them from test.raw.json).
41 tasks errored with Playwright 'Timeout 500ms exceeded' inside the native fetch_browser_info (harness-level); counted as failures.
Early stops dominate the failures: same action x3 (237), same typing x3 (103), max steps (101), parse failures x3 (98).
Single run, temperature 0, one seed; the actor is shared with other lanes (cold starts absorbed by retries).
